canonical_project: Papua New Guinea government Huawei-built data centre
owner: Government of Papua New Guinea / Huawei
notes: DCD reported on 2020-08-12 that Huawei built a PNG government data center in Port Moresby, funded by a US$53m Chinese state loan and opened in 2018, but with serious security and maintenance issues. Kept as operational because the facility existed and some departments had moved in, though reports said most had not and a rebuild may be required.
